column4: A source tool should preserve what the creator actually said before adding interpretation.
Every excerpt keeps its start and end timestamp, language, caption provenance and source version.
The first retrieval baseline uses lexical search because it is inspectable, fast and works fully offline.
Semantic search should be added only when an evaluation shows important paraphrased questions are being missed.
Visual analysis remains incomplete in this example, so the coverage record must say that clearly.
A calling agent receives compact evidence and performs the final reasoning without a second internal model call.
